g.text: of the rimbilliton.akn Minecraft server in a
visual way with all the components and how they
single OCI Always Free ARM VM
running NixOS. Pelican (Panel and Wings) manages the Minecraft
servers, users sign in with Pocket-ID SSO,
and world backups are shipped daily to Backblaze B2.

g.title: OIDC SSO provider (admin and minecraft groups)
ACME certificate authority (HTTP-01)
Off-site backup bucket
DNS-only record minecraft (no proxy)
Reverse proxy with automatic TLS for minecraft.chezmoi.sh and wings.minecraft.chezmoi.sh
Web UI and API, sign-in through Pocket-ID (Docker container)
Daemon that runs each game server in a Docker container (Docker container)
Game servers created and managed from Pelican, one port each from the pool
Daily encrypted backups of Pelican archives and panel data
SSH and deployments, OCI SSH stays closed
